proposed_improvements.recommendation: Measure connector/port geometry, insertion axis, clearance and seating with calibrated instruments; do not treat USB-C owner labels as fit evidence.
Verify adapter output, cable capability, phone input requirements and negotiation with independent electrical checks; visible contact does not verify charging.
Confirm which physical cable and which free end is intended, with tracked identity across recordings; do not assert same-cable identity across separate captures.
Replace static cable mesh transfer with validated deformable cable model and measured routing/strains for any development planning.
Calibrate metric scale, align camera/world frames, and validate robot reach, grasp, collision and contact geometry before any robot planning; separate recording frames are not merged.
Keep mains step blocked until exact socket/prong standard, de-energized state, and approved execution setup are validated by qualified procedure.
Add independent seating and charging-state checks; draft contains evidence-linked templates only with no demonstrated cross-recording success or executable actions.

result.summary: Metadata-only critique of a conditional development draft composing separate phone and charger captures; no cross-recording identity, fit, electrical compatibility, insertion success, charging, metric accuracy, or robot readiness is verified.
